title: Deviant authentication mechanism on sensitive route
description: Endpoint /api/v1/users/{user_id} implements an inline custom authorization check differing from the dominant require_auth decorator pattern.

evidence.snippet:
if not current_user.is_admin:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail='Forbidden')
evidence.description: Inline imperative role check instead of declared dependency guard.

unproven_assumptions: Assumes current_user object is populated by upstream middleware.
